name: LocalCloud MCP Server
description: Local stdio MCP server for LocalCloud runtime, services, diagnostics, logs, state, docs, and constrained local gcloud dry-runs.

LOCALCLOUD_MCP_ENABLE_STATE_RESET.description: Opt in to LocalCloud reset endpoint calls when confirm is true.

tools.name: localcloud-runtime
tools.description: Inspect and manage LocalCloud Docker runtime; destructive actions require confirmation.

tools.name: localcloud-services
tools.description: List services, ports, env vars, docs, supported behavior, and known gaps.

tools.name: localcloud-diagnostics
tools.description: Check Docker, ports, health, env vars, and routing pitfalls.

tools.name: localcloud-logs
tools.description: Return bounded summaries, errors, requests, or raw logs.

tools.name: localcloud-state
tools.description: Inspect state; reset is opt-in and confirmation-gated.

tools.name: localcloud-docs
tools.description: Return canonical local.cloud docs and prompt references.

tools.name: localcloud-gcp-client
tools.description: Dry-run planning for allowlisted local gcloud argv; execution is disabled pending safe runtime-generated override validation.
